description_en: Updates a specified node and synchronizes the changes to DataStudio to create a new saved version
description_zh: 更新指定任务，并同步到数据开发新增保存版本
name: UpdateTaskAsync

parameters.help_en: The client unique code of the node, which uniquely identifies a node. This code is used for asynchronous operations and idempotence. If you do not specify this parameter during creation, the system automatically generates one. The code is uniquely bound to the resource ID. When updating or deleting a resource, if you specify this parameter, it must be the same as the client unique code specified during creation
parameters.help_zh: 任务的客户端唯一码，用来唯一标识一个任务。用于实现异步和幂等，创建时如果不指定，系统将自动生成，该代码将与资源ID进行唯一绑定。更新、删除资源时如果指定该参数，应与创建时的客户端唯一码保持统一
parameters.name: client_unique_code

parameters.help_en:
The project environment. Valid values:

Prod: production
Dev: development
parameters.help_zh:
项目环境。

Prod：生产
Dev：开发
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the node owner. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the top navigation bar to view the account ID. If this parameter is left empty, the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the caller is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 任务的责任人的账号 ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，鼠标悬停至顶部菜单栏右侧的用户头像，查看账号ID。如果该参数为空，则默认使用调用者的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The instance generation mode. Valid values:
T+1: Generates instances the next day.
Immediately: Generates instances immediately. Note: Only periodic instances whose scheduled time is at least 10 minutes after the node publish time are generated. During the full instance generation period (22:00 to 24:00), real-time instance generation is not available. You can submit and publish nodes, but new nodes do not automatically generate instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例生成模式。
T+1（第二天生成）
Immediately（立即生成）。注意：节点定时时间在节点发布时间点十分钟后的周期实例才会正常生成。全量转实例期间（22:00~24:00点期间）不能进行实时转实例，可以提交发布节点，但新增节点不会自动转出实例
parameters.name: instance_mode

parameters.help_en: The timeout setting for scheduling configuration
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node can be rerun. Valid values:
AllDenied: Cannot be rerun regardless of success or failure.
FailureAllowed: Can be rerun only upon failure.
AllAllowed: Can be rerun regardless of success or failure
parameters.help_zh:
任务是否允许重跑的配置。
AllDenied：失败或成功都不可重跑
FailureAllowed：只有失败可重跑
AllAllowed：失败或成功均可重跑
parameters.name: rerun_mode

parameters.help_en: The number of retries. This parameter takes effect when the node is configured to allow reruns
parameters.help_zh: 重试次数，当任务设置为可重跑时生效
parameters.name: rerun_times

parameters.help_en: The retry time interval, in milliseconds. The value cannot exceed 1800000
parameters.help_zh: 重试时间间隔，单位毫秒。（不得超过1800000）
parameters.name: rerun_interval

fields.help_en:
The epoch type. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to Scheduler and the cron expression specifies timed scheduling within a specific hour. Default value: Daily. Valid values:
Daily: daily scheduling
NotDaily: hourly scheduling
fields.help_zh:
周期类型，Type=Scheduler 且 Cron表达式为指定某小时定时调度时生效。默认为Daily。
Daily：指定为天调度
NotDaily：指定为小时调度
fields.name: cycle_type

fields.help_en: The time when the periodic trigger expires. This parameter takes effect when type is set to Scheduler. Format: `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`
fields.help_zh: 周期触发失效时间，type=Scheduler时生效。格式为`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The run mode when the trigger fires. This parameter takes effect when type is set to Scheduler. Valid values:
Pause: paused
Skip: dry run
Normal: normal execution
fields.help_zh:
触发时的运行模式，type=Scheduler时生效。
Pause：暂停
Skip：空跑
Normal：正常运行
fields.name: recurrence

fields.help_en: The effective period of the epoch trigger. This parameter takes effect when type is set to Scheduler. Format: `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`
fields.help_zh: 周期触发生效时间，type=Scheduler时生效。格式为`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en:
The trigger type. Valid values:

Scheduler: periodic scheduling trigger
Manual: manual trigger
fields.help_zh:
触发方式类型。

Scheduler：调度周期触发
Manual：手动触发

The dependency type. Valid values:

CrossCycleDependsOnChildren: cross-cycle dependency on first-level child nodes
CrossCycleDependsOnSelf: cross-cycle dependency on the current node
CrossCycleDependsOnOtherNode: cross-cycle dependency on other nodes
Normal: same-cycle dependency

fields.help_zh: 上游任务的Id。（`跨周期依赖其他节点`与`同周期依赖`未设置input内容时，返回此字段，其他情况不返回）

OperationId.description_en: The operation ID, which is used to obtain the result of the asynchronous node update. You can call the UpdateTaskAsync operation to obtain the result
OperationId.description_zh: 操作ID，用于异步更新任务的结果，可通过`UpdateTaskAsync`接口获得

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题
